findings.title: Login has no visible brute-force protection
findings.description: The login endpoint returned failures but never a 429 or lockout, and no rate-limiting directive in the gateway or Ingress configuration covers it, so password guessing is not being slowed down.

evidence: no rate-limiting directive on its gateway route or Ingress
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting and lockout to /uaa/oauth/token.
mitigation: Rate-limit login per account and per IP (e.g. 5 failures / 15 min) and return 429.
Add MFA for privileged accounts and alert on failure spikes.

findings.title: Public entry serves the API without TLS
findings.description: The public entry (Ingress, load balancer, Istio Gateway or published port) has no TLS, so Authorization headers and personal data sent through it can be read or replayed on the network. The evidence says how many public endpoints carried them in this capture.
findings.detail: published port (docker compose) gateway serves the API over plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Enable TLS on published port (docker compose) gateway.
mitigation: Terminate TLS at the ingress (tls: section + certificate) and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
Send Strict-Transport-Security so browsers never fall back to HTTP.
findings.snippet:
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts: [api.example.com]
      secretName: api-tls
